--Petitioner
 Versus
Certifying Officer Of Standing Orders/ 
Regional Deputy Labour Commissioner
--Respondent
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J
1. Mr. S.S. Nigam, learned Senior Counsel 
assisted by Mr. Amar Murti Shukla, learned 
counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Pradeep Hariya, learned Additional 
C.S.C. for the State of Uttarakhand. 
3. Petitioner is permitted to serve 
respondent no. 3, personally.
4. Steps to be taken within 24 hours.
5. List this case on 06.10.2026, as fresh.
6. In the meantime, affidavit of service be 
filed. 
7. Till the next date of listing, parties shall 
maintain status quo.
8. It is made clear that interim order shall 
not be extended if service is not effected 
upon respondent no. 3. 
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J)
 28.09.2026
Aswal
